response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medication (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs) prescribed as part of treatment for an acute injury (ankle sprain) that occurred during travel. Clause A4.1 explicitly covers the cost of medications prescribed by a doctor for acute illness or injury during travel. There is no indication of pre-existing conditions, planned treatment, or any of the exclusions listed in the A5 or A11 clauses."}
